edits.value_json: "备" is used for “prepare,” “be ready or complete,” and “equipment.” Its modern visible split is 夂 above 田, but that split is not established as its historical construction. Traditional 備 is interpreted either as a person carrying a container or, in another account, as a whole container holding arrows.

Modern 备 is visibly split into upper 夂 and lower 田. Traditional 備 is interpreted as a person carrying a container, a scene linked with readiness; 备 is its officially standardized simplified counterpart, but its visible split is not established as that historical construction.
夂 is the visible upper part of modern 备; its historical role in this graph is unresolved.
田 is the visible lower part of modern 备; its historical role in this graph is unresolved.
